text:
sam: Dropping the pen-test + external vuln-scan bundle for CustomerCorp's security review. Need owners and remediation ETAs so sales can get RiskOps signoff by EOD Friday. S3 folder attached below. Please call out any PII we need to redact before sharing. :eyes:

sam: S3: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/customercorp/2060012345/ (private link)
Checksums: SHA256: 8f2d1a9b6c4a9f3b5d0e2c6a9b3f0c9d1a2e3f4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b

lara: Thanks — pinging security owners. Is the original Nessus/full Burp report included or only the exported CSV? We need raw scans + findings mapping for our remediation tracker. Also legal asked to remove screenshots with customer PII before external handoff. :thumbsup:

sam: Included both raw_nessus.xml and burp_project.json plus summarized findings.csv in the folder. I redacted obvious customer emails from screenshots but left HTTP traces. If anything more must be redacted let me know and I'll pull a redacted copy.

kevin: Assigned infra-side owner: @kevin. I'll triage the 5 critical/high findings this afternoon. Can someone paste the exploit/repro steps for the top critical? I can't access the Burp GUI on my laptop right now.

ben: I grabbed the exported findings.csv. Top CRITICAL is 202-ECOM-001: unauth SSRF in image proxy (exploit: POST /api/fetch?url=\u003chost\u003e). Repro steps in CSV column 'repro'. Short version: curl -X POST 'https://staging.customercorp.com/api/fetch?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'

anna-sre: I'll take ownership of the KV-caching service remediation (202-ECOM-001). Plan: add outbound egress whitelist + input validation. ETA for patch PR: 48h. I'll open a tracking ticket and link here. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks anna-sre. Can you add an acceptance test that verifies no EC2 metadata returned? devsec-bot requested that for STS verification.

devsec-bot: Required acceptance test: attempt metadata fetch from app sandbox; expected 403 or empty response. See policy: https://intranet.redwood/sec/policies/ssrf-hardening

kevin: Created ticket RW-4589 and assigned to anna-sre + kevin. ETA: PR by 2060012545, staging patch rollout 2060012568. I'll update with links.

lara: Quick note on medium findings: a bunch are third-party library CVEs (libxml2, 2021-44228-like patterns). We should patch images and run full image rebuilds. I'll run vuln-scan of the built image and post results.

ben: For evidence consumption, here's how to validate artifacts quickly:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-sec-evidence/customercorp/2060012345/burp_project.json ./
sha256sum burp_project.json
# compare with provided SHA256
```

sam: Also, customer asked for a remediation timeline summary PDF. Can someone compile a one-pager with owners, PR links, and expected close dates? Need it by tomorrow noon.

kevin: I'll export a short timeline and link it to the ticket. Expect a draft in ~3 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lara: Heads up — legal flagged credential exposure in screenshots as high sensitivity. Sam, please confirm redaction or remove those images from the shared folder before external review.

sam: Will do a final scrub and upload redacted evidence to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/customercorp/2060012345/redacted/ by 2060012460.

anna-sre: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/customercorp-repo/pull/1123 — includes whitelist + unit tests for metadata blocking. Requesting review from kevin and ben.

ben: Reviewed and left comments. Quick fix required in proxy handler (missing URL parse validation). ETA for follow-up commit: 2h.

kevin: Follow-up commit pushed and CI passing. Will queue staging rollout at 2060012555.

lara: Great. Once staging verification is green, we'll prepare the remediation summary PDF and an artifacts checklist for the customer's vendor-risk portal.

sam: Big thanks all. I'll update the customer and RiskOps once the staging validation passes. :pray:
